title: Ordered affine compact supports and actual trace maps
statement:
Use the finite-coefficient setting [def-pur-conventions], with $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ and $Y$ a separated finite-type $k$-scheme. Use the ordered affine-space model $p_d:X_d\to Y$ of [def-sbc-affine-space, def-pur-affine-space-comparison], the shifted Tate coefficients of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], and the constructible exceptional adjunction of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Define $C_0=\mathrm{id}$ and $C_d=Rp_{d!}$ for $d>0$, and $T_d=A_{X_d}(d)[2d]$ with the specified ordered tensor powers. The coefficient pullback isomorphism $u_f:Lf^*A_Y\simeq A_X$ is the canonical one obtained through the etale/pro-etale site comparison. Put $F_dK=Lp_d^*K\otimes_A^LT_d$. Let $e_d:F_d(A_Y)\simeq T_d$ be its ordered-twist image and $\Gamma_{d,A_Y}$ the specified ordered purity comparison. Define the actual integration
$$I_d=C_d(e_d^{-1});C_d(\Gamma_{d,A_Y});\varepsilon_{p_d,A_Y}:C_dT_d\longrightarrow A_Y,$$
using normalized identity data in dimension zero. Define $t_Y:C_1T_1\to A_Y$ by transporting the normalized affine-line integration of [def-pur-affine-line-purity-comparison] through its canonical source, compactification and coefficient-unit comparisons. These are definitions of maps; no equality between $I_1$ and $t_Y$, projection formula or composite-transpose theorem is asserted.

lean.statement:
def integration (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY] [IsSeparated aY] (d : ℕ) :
    (compact P Y d).obj (tate P Y d) ⟶ unit (Ring P) Y
